info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.a.0: Lets the Crystallizer also grow Spectrum crystals.
info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.a.1: No ink is consumed at all.
info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.b.0: The growth fluid must be present in the input tank (it is not used up).
info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.b.1: Additives are consumed at their usual rate and speed growth up.
info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.c.0: Ink is ignored entirely, so ink-related boosts do not apply either.
info.thermal.augment.crystallarieum.c.1: Only one specialization upgrade takes effect per machine.
info.thermal.augment.distillation.a.0: Focuses the Fractionating Still on fractionating concentrated metals.
info.thermal.augment.distillation.a.1: Base energy use is reduced to 25%, and base output is increased to 200%.
info.thermal.augment.distillation.b.0: Only concentrated-metal fractionation recipes can be run.
info.thermal.augment.distillation.c.0: Only one specialization upgrade takes effect per machine.

info.thermal.augment.lava_production.a.0: Focuses the Magma Crucible on producing lava.
